_doc: The standard bench runs Jev suggests from (harness/queue-jev.py suggest; queue.sh submit run --bench <name>|auto, queue.sh suggest). Every entry names the resources it tests; the vocabulary is `resources` (the Options tab's effect rows plus gc, frame-pacing, visual-parity). `args` are run.sh arguments without --label; the submit appends the session's own arguments after -- (label, --prop A/B keys, --record ...). Add an entry when a new rig becomes a standard; keep resources honest, Jev classifies by them.

resources.game-thread: the main game-logic thread: world update, zombies, player, Lua, chunk bakes issued, lighting JNI
resources.render-thread: the GL / render thread: draw submission, VBO batching, texture uploads
resources.other-cores: worker threads: parallel zombie batches, bone math, lighting reads, chunk loading pool
resources.gpu: GPU busy time: fill rate, shaders, chunk-texture composites, weather, fog, puddles
resources.vram: GPU memory: chunk textures kept or freed (zoom), render targets
resources.ram: Java heap / native memory: population, loaded chunks, caches
resources.disk: chunk / save reads and writes while streaming, hot saves
resources.load-time: launch to menu and Continue to world
resources.chunk-arrival: how fast new chunks stream in and appear while moving
resources.gc: garbage-collector and JIT pauses: isolated hitches
resources.frame-pacing: frame-time consistency: p99 / p99.9 / spikes / jitter at the cap
resources.visual-parity: the picture matches stock: flicker, black squares, blocky lights, missing objects

benches.name: spin
benches.what: the game-thread route: south through Rosewood with the player facing spinning 90 deg/s at max zoom, 25 s; cutaways, vision and lighting cones change every frame

benches.name: spin-uncapped
benches.what: the spin route with no frame cap and the UI drawn offscreen: headroom above 240 fps, which of GPU / render / game thread is the wall
benches.args: --mode bench --flag route=S:450 --flag turn=90 --flag zoom=max --route-seconds 25 --prop instrument=true --prop uncappedFps=true --option uiRenderOffscreen=true --no-dashboard

benches.name: bench-100
benches.what: the classic 100 s fixed-camera bench route at max zoom: chunk latency and the frame tail at the cap

benches.name: walk-hitch
benches.what: slow spinning walk (3 tiles/s, 40 s) with G1 at a 25 ms pause goal: isolated GC / JIT / save hitches, not throughput
benches.args: --mode bench --flag route=S:120 --flag speed=3 --flag turn=90 --flag zoom=max --route-seconds 40 --gc g1 --vmarg -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=25 --prop instrument=true --no-dashboard --no-mangohud

benches.name: drive-120
benches.what: 120 km/h path drive east on KY-60, 1,200 tiles from 8010 (~43 s, stops at the end): the heaviest chunk streaming and bake load; the path pilot holds the line and the speed, drive_check.py (Jev) says whether the drive was clean
benches.args: --mode drive --flag path=8010,11204.5/9210,11204.5 --flag kmh=120 --flag zoom=max --route-seconds 60 --option frameRate=240 --option uncappedFPS=false --prop instrument=true --no-dashboard

benches.name: drive-120-south
benches.what: 120 km/h path drive through Rosewood: KY-60 east 96 tiles from 8010,11204.5 (8 tiles past the bench save's own car at 8002,11204), right onto North Main St, south 761 tiles through the town (Jacks Lane), stop before Angel Road; the path pilot holds the line, brakes for the corner, obstacles and the end; drive_check.py (Jev) says whether the drive was clean
benches.args: --mode drive --flag path=8010,11204.5/8106,11204.5/8106,11965.5 --flag kmh=120 --flag zoom=max --route-seconds 60 --option frameRate=240 --option uncappedFPS=false --prop instrument=true --no-dashboard

benches.name: drive-60
benches.what: 60 km/h path drive east on KY-60, 1,200 tiles from 8010 (~77 s): the steady streaming A/B route
benches.args: --mode drive --flag path=8010,11204.5/9210,11204.5 --flag kmh=60 --flag max_seconds=120 --flag zoom=max --route-seconds 90 --option frameRate=240 --option uncappedFPS=false --prop instrument=true --no-dashboard

benches.name: storm
benches.what: spin route in a pinned thunderstorm with lightning every 6 s: rain particles, puddles, splashes, lightning re-bakes

benches.name: fog
benches.what: spin route with fog pinned at 1.0: the fog pass (fill rate, depth reads)

benches.name: storm-fog
benches.what: storm plus heavy fog: the worst weather the game rolls

benches.name: night-torch
benches.what: 01:00 with a lit torch sweeping as the player spins: dynamic lights, lighting re-bakes, blocky-light artefacts (judge from the recording)

benches.name: louisville
benches.what: downtown Louisville with the population maxed (~2,000-2,500 zombies), slow spin: zombie simulation, animation, characters draw; no see_all since 2026-09-23 (never-seen blocks black, no re-bake flood), compare only with runs after that

benches.name: helicopter
benches.what: the stock helicopter event over the spin route: its moving 500-radius world sound

benches.name: alarm-storm
benches.what: a house-alarm-style 600-radius world sound every frame from one square, in a storm: WorldSoundManager.addSound cost

benches.name: zoom-cycle
benches.what: camera zoom stepping 0.25 -> 2.5 and jumps every 3 s: chunk textures freed / re-baked on zoom (zoomsteps.py)
benches.args: --mode bench --flag route=S:450 --flag zoom=0.25 --flag zoom_cycle=3 --flag zoom_span=9 --flag zoom_jump=true --prop instrument=true --no-dashboard

benches.name: flicker
benches.what: the flicker rig: spin then hold 10 s at zoom 1, recorded; flicker.py counts per-frame appear / disappear pixels over the hold
benches.args: --mode bench --flag route=S:450 --flag speed=90 --flag turn=90 --flag hold=10 --flag zoom=1 --route-seconds 16 --prop instrument=true --no-dashboard --record

benches.name: shot
benches.what: screenshot rig: camera held 8 s into the route, game + desktop captures for blacktiles.py against a control run

benches.name: horde-shoot
benches.what: stability + ragdolls: Jev (showcase-director.py, start it with --runs N before the jobs) directs a player (zombies never attack: no_attack=true) shooting a horde of 150 fast zombies with an M16 at the Riverside pier in daylight, no fire; pzopt.RagdollWatch logs every ragdoll episode (pzopt-ragdoll.out), harness/ragdoll-judge.py compares stock (--prop enabled=false) with optimized: crashes, exceptions, off-thread ragdolls, flying / sliding / spinning / sunken bodies
benches.args: --mode bench --flag start=6445,5195 --flag pier=6436,5186 --flag horde_dir=SE --flag time_of_day=12 --flag weather=clear --flag showcase=horde --flag director=jev --flag burn=false --flag fire_line=false --flag no_attack=true --flag horde=150 --flag mags=20 --flag route=S:1 --flag speed=0.02 --flag hold=10 --flag zoom=1 --record --launcher direct --no-dashboard --no-mangohud --prop overlay=false --option focusloss=false --option panCameraWhileAiming=false

benches.name: load
benches.what: boot and Continue-to-world timing with a short path drive (60 tiles east on KY-60, stops by itself) so the run ends by itself; loadtime.py reads pzopt-loadtrace.out

benches.name: sound-storm-horde
benches.what: the sound engine under load: Louisville horde, thunderstorm, a house and a car alarm, a pistol fired twice a second, the helicopter; slow walk so every source stays in earshot; census at 4 Hz, the game's own audio recorded for audio-judge.py (Jev) and asprof for soundprof.py
benches.args: --preset louisville --flag weather=storm --flag house_alarm=12 --flag car_alarm=8 --flag gunshots=2 --flag helicopter=true --flag sound_probe_hz=4 --flag route=S:25 --flag speed=1 --route-seconds 25 --record --record-audio game --asprof event=cpu,interval=5ms,threads --prop instrument=true --prop uncappedFps=true --no-dashboard --launcher direct
